Thoughts on this?

" I just realized something most people are going to lose when (as they inevitably will) they start using AIs to write everything for them. They'll lose the knowledge of how writing is constructed.
This is a very common kind of knowledge to be lost as technology progresses. Very few people now know how to weave cloth or turn pots or make baskets. But it's strange to think that writing will now enter this category.
And indeed I worry that something much bigger will be lost when most people stop writing. It's not that big a loss if you don't weave your own cloth. But writing is thinking. So if people stop writing, that's a whole kind of thinking they'll stop doing.
Schools may think they're going to stem this tide, but we should be honest about what's going to happen. Writing is hard and people don't like doing hard things. So adults will stop doing it, and it will feel very artificial to most kids who are made to.
Writing (and the kind of thinking that goes with it) will become like making pottery: little kids will do it in school, a few specialists will be amazingly good at it, and everyone else will be unable to do it at all. "

Game theory
As an expert and scientist in Game theory and optimization, carefully evaluate the following problem: 
- First, evaluate the assumptions of the problem below and, if necessary, add assumptions or supplement the current assumptions. and then 
- Formulate it as a Game model to minimize costs.
- Use a scientific and mathematical standard for naming sets, indices, variables, and problem parameters. 
- And write the text professionally and with an academic and scientific tone. 
- Here's a Problem Definition:
Consider a system that offers two alternative services. Users first log in to the system and use the service they want if it is available, and use the alternative service if it is not available. There are two groups of users, each group preferring one of the services, but if the server for the service is busy, they use the alternative service. The arrival rate of each group of customers (users) is Poisson (λ1,λ2). If both types of servers are busy, customers remain in the waiting queue. The question is how many servers should be provided for type 1 and type 2 services. The server service rates are μ1,μ2, respectively, and the purchase cost of each server is c1,c2.

🏆 Today's Activity – Topic Presentation 🎤

"Speak on What Inspires You!"

🎯 Students will present a 4-slide PowerPoint on a topic of their choice, sharing insights, ideas, or information in an engaging and structured way.

🎯 Each student will have 3 minutes to present.

‼ For Students Who Have a Specific Topic in Mind:
Your presentation should include:

📌 Slide 1: Title & Introduction – What is your topic and why did you choose it?

📌 Slide 2: Background/Context – Provide some basic information or context about the topic.

📌 Slide 3: Key Insights – Share 2–3 interesting or important points related to your topic.

📌 Slide 4: Your Thoughts – What are your views or takeaways? Why is this topic important or relevant?

‼ For Students Who Are Still Exploring Topics:
If you're unsure or still exploring, present on something you're curious about or learning recently:

📌 What drew your interest to this area?
📌 What have you found out so far?
📌 What do you hope to learn more about?

 ✅ Guidelines:

⏳ Duration:  3 minutes per student
📂 Format: PowerPoint (4 slides)
🎯 Focus: Clear, concise, and confidently delivered presentation

✨ Choose a topic you’re passionate or curious about — and make it your moment to shine!

I’ve been at the job since then and now I’ve been at the mall since then. It is currently April 17th and I’m gearing up to go home. My parents said they’re find with me being there for the summer. There are a few conditions though. 1. I got to make my payments on time that I owe them which is $61 for my phone and then another $217 for a loan repayment. This April I have only $70 of that left to pay. I’m getting a student loan for summer expenses and that is expected to land on May 10th. I’m really struggling to stay at the security job so I’m trying to get out of it asap. We have tested junk removal ads which is our plan for making money this summer they have worked everytime we texted them converting at around $50 per customer cost and $100-150 customer profit. Right now I have access to $1300 in capital with $1170 of expenses including all businesses expenses before the student loan hits. I’m bringing my cat who is quite scared of other people and animals. My parents will be gone this weekend the 18tg through 20th so ideally I could go back now what do you think of this plan
